name: openbot
description: Self-hosted digital employee control plane with replaceable execution nodes.

scripts.check: npm run ci:check && npm run oracle:check && npm run test:browser:boundary && npm run docs:check && npm run research:check && npm run server:architecture:check && npm run server:container:check && npm run migrations:check && npm run security:config-check && npm run worker-host:macos:check && npm run release:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:linux:contracts && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.db:up: docker compose --env-file .env -p openbot-python-dev -f deploy/server/compose.dev.yaml up -d postgres
scripts.db:stop: docker compose --env-file .env -p openbot-python-dev -f deploy/server/compose.dev.yaml stop postgres
scripts.docs:check: node --test scripts/check-developer-entrypoints.test.ts scripts/check-docs.test.ts scripts/check-hygiene.test.ts && node scripts/check-docs.ts && node scripts/check-hygiene.ts
scripts.release:check: node --test scripts/argument-pairs.test.ts scripts/issue-node-enrollment.test.ts scripts/production-package-graph.test.ts scripts/release-source.test.ts scripts/node-linux-release.test.ts scripts/node-linux-candidate.test.ts scripts/node-linux-install-lease.test.ts scripts/node-linux-archive-import.test.ts scripts/node-linux-privileged-layout.test.ts scripts/node-linux-bootstrap.test.ts scripts/node-linux-bootstrap-command.test.ts scripts/node-linux-install-transaction.test.ts scripts/node-linux-provenance.test.ts scripts/node-linux-extract.test.ts scripts/node-linux-systemd.test.ts scripts/prepare-desktop-release.test.ts scripts/install-desktop.test.ts scripts/create-mcp-plugin.test.ts
scripts.security:config-check: node --test scripts/check-credential-findings.test.ts scripts/check-security-workflow.test.ts scripts/check-node-release-workflow.test.ts scripts/check-windows-worker-host-workflow.test.ts && node scripts/check-security-workflow.ts && node scripts/check-node-release-workflow.ts && node scripts/check-windows-worker-host-workflow.ts
scripts.typecheck: turbo run build --filter=@openbot/db --filter=@openbot/protocol --filter=@openbot/server --filter=@openbot/node && tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p experiments/work-journey/tsconfig.json && turbo run typecheck
scripts.worker-host:macos:native-check: swift build --package-path apps/worker-host-macos && swift test --package-path apps/worker-host-macos
scripts.oracle:build: npm run oracle:check && turbo run build --filter=@openbot/legacy-server-oracle^... && npm run build:oracle --workspace @openbot/legacy-server-oracle
scripts.contracts:http:ts: npm exec -- turbo run build --filter=@openbot/db --filter=@openbot/server && node scripts/test-contracts-ts.ts
scripts.contracts:http:tls: npm exec -- turbo run build --filter=@openbot/db --filter=@openbot/server && node scripts/test-contracts-tls.ts
scripts.contracts:test: npm exec -- turbo run build --filter=@openbot/web^... && npm exec --workspace @openbot/web -- vitest run --config vitest.contract.config.ts && npm run test --workspace @openbot/contract-tests
scripts.ci:check: node --test scripts/ci-scope.test.ts scripts/ui-acceptance-report.test.ts scripts/check-ci-cache.test.ts scripts/acceptance-fixture.test.ts scripts/output-redaction.test.ts scripts/smoke-dev-startup.test.ts scripts/dev-startup-inputs.test.ts scripts/dev-processes.test.ts experiments/work-journey/product-browser-upstream.test.ts experiments/work-journey/browser-worker-restart.test.ts experiments/work-journey/native-host-baseline.test.ts experiments/work-journey/probe-inputs.test.ts experiments/work-journey/browser_response_loss.test.ts scripts/temporal-release.test.ts scripts/temporal-upgrade.test.ts scripts/temporal-maintenance.test.ts
scripts.test:work:ts: npm exec -- turbo run build --filter=@openbot/server --filter=@openbot/db --filter=@openbot/node && npm exec -- vitest run --config scripts/vitest.integration.config.ts scripts/work-control.integration.test.ts scripts/work-product.integration.test.ts scripts/legacy-work-preflight.integration.test.ts
scripts.test:control:ts: npm exec -- turbo run build --filter=@openbot/server --filter=@openbot/db --filter=@openbot/node && npm exec -- vitest run --config scripts/vitest.integration.config.ts scripts/control-cohorts.integration.test.ts scripts/command-compatibility.integration.test.ts
scripts.test:temporal:upgrade: npm exec -- turbo run build --filter=@openbot/server --filter=@openbot/node && npm exec -- vitest run --config scripts/vitest.integration.config.ts scripts/temporal-upgrade.integration.test.ts
scripts.test:temporal:boundary: npm exec -- turbo run build --filter=@openbot/server --filter=@openbot/node && npm exec -- vitest run --config scripts/vitest.integration.config.ts scripts/temporal-boundary.integration.test.ts
scripts.test:linux:contracts: npm exec -- turbo run build --filter=@openbot/server && node --test experiments/linux-execution/*.test.ts experiments/work-journey/product-host-boundary.test.ts experiments/work-journey/product-native-protocol.test.ts experiments/work-journey/product-native-controller.test.ts experiments/work-journey/product-browser-native.test.ts experiments/work-journey/browser-native-controller.test.ts experiments/work-journey/browser-product-fixture.test.ts experiments/work-journey/native-packet-*.test.ts experiments/work-journey/native-browser-*.test.ts
